verdict.rationale: incident.io documents native Slack and Microsoft Teams incident response, automatic Teams meetings, and a GitHub integration that links PRs to the incident channel and syncs exported follow-up issues. A changelog entry also describes two-way sync for incident tickets, though it does not name a tracker. Jira and Zoom are never named in the evidence, so two of the five listed tools are unproven. missing for 10: explicit Jira integration evidence, any Zoom integration evidence, bidirectional sync detail for Slack/Teams, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, the platform integrates with the tools around the incident — Jira, Slack, Teams, Zoom, GitHub — so state flows both ways

citations.quote: you can do it right from where your team already works, whether that's Slack or Microsoft Teams
Connect pull requests and get updates in your incident channel. Export follow-ups as GitHub Issues and we'll sync any changes.
Automatically start a Microsoft Teams meeting for each incident.
You can now configure incident tickets to update the incident when the ticket changes, as well as updating the ticket when the incident changes.
Export and automatically sync your incident actions with tickets in Asana.
